nodes.description: Satellite platform architecture integrating structure, command and data handling, power, thermal control, attitude and orbit control, propulsion, and payload interfaces.
Satellite final assembly, integration, functional test, interface verification, and acceptance before delivery to the launch campaign.
Hardware payload architecture and integration for satellite communications, navigation augmentation, earth observation, scientific instruments, and space information acquisition.

nodes.node_name: Communications, Navigation, and Remote-Sensing Payload Hardware
nodes.description: Antennas, transponders, phased arrays, navigation payloads, optical or radar instruments, and payload electronics integrated on satellites; downstream application services remain outside this manufacturing node.

nodes.node_name: Onboard Avionics, TT&C, and Data Handling
nodes.description: Onboard computers, telemetry tracking and command, timing, data handling, inertial and sensing electronics integrated for satellite operation.

nodes.node_name: Satellite Power, Thermal, Attitude, and Orbit Control
nodes.description: Solar-array and power conditioning, thermal control, attitude determination and control, reaction or momentum devices, and in-orbit propulsion integrated for platform reliability.

nodes.node_name: Spaceborne RF and Microwave Component Integration
nodes.description: Space-qualified RF, microwave, millimeter-wave, ADC/DAC, frequency, power-amplifier, and beamforming components integrated into satellite payload and TT&C chains; generic semiconductor ownership remains with semiconductor and RF component chains.
Satellite-specific ground stations, telemetry tracking and command systems, gateways, network management, and terminal integration connecting spacecraft with operators and users.

nodes.node_name: Satellite Ground TT&C, Gateway, and Terminal Integration
nodes.description: Satellite-specific antennas, RF front ends, modems, gateways, TT&C systems, and user-terminal integration; terrestrial network equipment ownership remains with network equipment, edge IoT, and optical communications chains.
Design standardization, modular production, supply-chain coordination, production-line takt, yield, and repeatable delivery for batch satellite manufacturing.
Assembly, integration and test plus vibration, thermal-vacuum, electromagnetic compatibility, reliability, and acceptance qualification required for repeatable spacecraft delivery.
Contracted spacecraft delivery, launch handoff, orbit insertion confirmation, commissioning, constellation networking, and capacity activation tracked as separate milestones.

nodes.node_name: Satellite Delivery, Launch, and In-Orbit Boundary
nodes.description: Separates constellation plans, contracts, satellite delivery, launch, commissioning, and in-orbit acceptance; commercial_space_launch ownership remains with launch vehicles, launch operations, and payload orbit-delivery interfaces.
In-orbit fleet control, health management, capacity scheduling, gateway coordination, maintenance engineering, and availability management for operational satellite infrastructure.

nodes.node_name: Satellite Service Capacity and Revenue Validation
nodes.description: Validates commissioned in-orbit capacity, utilization, customer contracts, recurring satellite operations or capacity revenue, and cash collection separately from planned constellation capacity.
